limitations: Finite seeds and routes; not a proof of indefinitely bug-free gameplay.
Historical Editor native shutdown/refresh hang remains unresolved; idle Editors are retained.
P3k fixes a scene radius override, and P3l fixes occupied approach selection with deterministic dual-agent scene reproductions; older transient failures are not all assigned the same cause.
Approach occupancy checks physical colliders belonging to other active NavMeshAgents; collider-free external navigation agents are outside this helper coverage.
Historical transient Search/Unreachable at the canteen was not independently reproduced; the separate high-baseOffset defect has a deterministic regression test.
Known missing scripts and scene warnings remain documented.
FFT inactive changes belong to the user working tree and are not included in the fix commits.
